[[Murakai's Blade]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from [[Murakai's Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Murakai, Lady of the Night]] in [[Cathedral of Flames]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same appearance as the [[Runic Blade]], [[dye]]d black.
